_README: Model quick-reference and UI preset source; generation does not load it automatically. Copy full chains into config/agent_llms.json or edit them in the UI. Syntax: provider:model@effort. claude/codex use only the official local CLI; codex_proxy/antigravity/grok/copilot use only CLIProxyAPI HTTP.

gemini._说明: Direct Gemini API. Reads GEMINI_API_KEY_1...N or GEMINI_API_KEY from .env.

claude._说明: Official local Claude CLI using the user's subscription login state. The shared gateway enforces text-only, no-tools, read-only execution. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

codex._说明: Official local Codex CLI using the user's ChatGPT subscription state in an ephemeral read-only run. Live model ids come from ~/.codex/models_cache.json. Effort depends on model and can include max/ultra.

codex_proxy._说明: CLIProxyAPI HTTP using the free Codex account pool. This identity is deliberately separate from the user's local Codex subscription CLI.

antigravity._说明: CLIProxyAPI HTTP. Use model IDs exposed by the local /v1/models endpoint.

grok._说明: CLIProxyAPI HTTP for xAI/Grok account. Effort can be inline with @medium/@high when the proxy supports it.

copilot._说明: CLIProxyAPI HTTP for GitHub Copilot account.

deepseek._说明: Direct DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible API. Reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from .env.

openrouter._说明: Direct OpenRouter OpenAI-compatible API. Reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY_1...N or OPENROUTER_API_KEY from .env.
